scientific_limitations: Finite symmetric Markov generators on star graphs only.
Exactly one exceptional edge jump rate in (0,1], all other edge rates one, all geometric lengths one.
The epsilon-to-zero expansion keeps the number of fast leaves fixed.
No claims about multiple defects, rescaled geometry, other Wasserstein orders, or normalized random walks.
title: Exact Wasserstein amplification on a rate-defect star and its metastable peak
